verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Firstbase offers registered-agent service in all 50 states at $299 per state per year. It also says Firstbase will 'legally change your registered agent', which is a generic statement that Firstbase handles the change. Nothing shows it publishes per-state appointment details: no per-state agent addresses and no named designation or change form for any state. The in-app dashboard that shows per-state requirements is an adjacent feature, not published appointment details, so it earns no credit here.
